description: Time-bound exceptions for concern adoption checks where migration is intentional and documented.

entries.justification: Headless Fastify API uses API key trust boundary rather than end-user session middleware.
Org context is currently inferred from orchestrator request metadata; migration to shared org context contract is tracked.
Public web remains thin and does not yet expose platform-contract adapters for governance endpoints.
Django-authoritative hybrid uses existing domain contract surfaces while route-level adapters are consolidated incrementally.
Partners relies on domain-shared contracts; migration to platform-contract adapters is in-progress.
Zonga events currently route through domain event packages; platform-events envelope migration is staged.
